about: The events of the files of a vault. Each event is about one file of the vault. An event with isTrigger is one a trigger of contributes.triggers runs on, and the file is the target of the trigger's condition and of the handler it runs; every event is an event of the core's file change feed. tools/events.mjs writes the Go lists from this file.

events.name: file.added
events.about: a file is added to the vault, or the core finds it for the first time

events.name: file.changed
events.about: the content of a file of the vault changes

events.name: file.moved
events.about: a file of the vault gets another path and keeps its content

events.name: file.removed
events.about: a file is removed from the vault

events.name: note.frontmatterChanged
events.about: the index stores a note whose frontmatter differs from what it held: the frontmatter changes, or a note with frontmatter is added or removed
